sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "matches"."winner_id" AS e, AVG((CAST("matches"."winner_rank_points" AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_rank_points")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("matches"."winner_ht" - "matches"."loser_ht") AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_ht")) AS m2, (AVG((CAST("matches"."winner_rank_points" AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_rank_points")) - AVG((CAST(("matches"."winner_ht" - "matches"."loser_ht") AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_ht"))) AS m3 FROM "matches" GROUP BY "matches"."winner_id") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
